name: Semgrep
description: Semgrep's hosted server scans code with Semgrep rules and reads findings from your Semgrep organization.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (login.semgrep.dev) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
